description: This Java class `BreadcrumbsUtils` provides utility functions to build breadcrumb navigation structures for categories and products in an e-commerce web application. It assembles breadcrumb items based on category lineage, product details, and store context.

classes.name: BreadcrumbsUtils
classes.description: A utility class to build breadcrumb navigation data for categories and products.

methods.name: buildCategoryBreadcrumb
methods.description: Constructs a breadcrumb trail for navigating through categories, based on a clicked category, store, and language.

methods.name: buildProductBreadcrumb
methods.description: Constructs a breadcrumb trail for a product page, including category hierarchy and product details.

methods.name: parseBreadCrumb
methods.description: Parses breadcrumb reference content string to extract category IDs.

methods.name: parseCategoryLineage
methods.description: Parses category lineage string into a list of category IDs.

methods.name: buildBreadCrumb
methods.description: Builds a breadcrumb reference string from a list of category IDs.
